answer: Each identity must post a unique stake bonded to a distinct proof-of-personhood ledge, so a sybil cluster cannot reuse the same shale of collateral across shadow accounts. A dynamic penalty curve taxes every new identity that joins an existing voting garden, making marginal sybil expansion strictly costlier than honest participation and preserving the non-collusive equilibrium. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
